verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a JavaScript SDK for web tracking, a Node SDK verified installable at runtime, and API/Pixel references for server-side track/identify/page-style event tracking, plus a standard event spec and Event Playground for testing. Community evidence corroborates real-world use replacing Segment for cross-platform analytics collection. missing for 10: explicit documented mobile SDK (iOS/Android) references and a single canonical spec page enumerating track/identify/page methods across all SDKs with independent hands-on confirmation for mobile/server SDKs.
